thread:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — enterprise asks are pushing us to standardize response metadata across chat, embeddings, rerank, and tool calls. Can we align on a minimal shape for launch gating? Need decision by EOD Fri.
Sam Wu: +1. Main friction: token fields naming (we currently have tokens_consumed, token_count, and cost_tokens across teams).
Jordan Lee: Proposal: canonical fields: request_tokens, response_tokens, total_tokens, trace_id, request_id, model, model_variant, quality_score (optional). Keep names explicit and stable.
Anika Gomez: For tool/function calling we also need tool_trace_id and tool_latency_ms. Customers want to tie model traces to downstream tool invocations.
Ravi Singh: Important: don't add too many optional fields for v1 — impacts bandwidth (mobile) and telemetry cost. Suggest keep core 6 fields and an open metadata map: metadata.*
Maya Patel: Example payload shape I'm proposing:
```json
{
  "request_id": "r_abc123",
  "trace_id": "t_20260320_001",
  "model": "redwood/gpt-7b",
  "model_variant": "q4_0",
  "request_tokens": 45,
  "response_tokens": 120,
  "total_tokens": 165,
  "cost_units": "micros", // internal only
  "metadata": {"customer_request_id":"crm-42"}
}
```
Sam Wu: Love it. Suggest renaming `cost_units` -> `token_cost_micro` and keep it internal-tagged. Also we need formal semantics for `request_tokens` vs `total_tokens` (prefix included?) — doc must define request = input tokens, response = output tokens, total = sum.
Jordan Lee: Launch gating checklist: 1) SDKs expose fields consistently (JS/Py/Go), 2) E2E tests for token accounting, 3) telemetry dashboard mapped to fields, 4) fallback behavior when fields absent (SDK should populate nulls), 5) migration notes for customers.
Anika Gomez: Agrees. For structured output/tool calling: we should add `function_calls` array with elements `{name, call_id, trace_id, latency_ms, success}` but mark as v1 opt-in.
Ravi Singh: Perf note — adding arrays increases payload size for streaming. Make `function_calls` only present in final response envelope (not per incremental chunk) and include compact fields.
Maya Patel: Prioritization: Customer-driven asks -> high (2 large enterprise POCs), Platform reliability/instrumentation -> high, Backwards compat and rollout docs -> medium. We have one sprint to get baseline contract in place for Hosted API beta launch.
Sam Wu: Questions for PMs: what's the minimum eval we accept before gating? Do we require token accounting parity with Dedicated?
Maya Patel: Minimum eval = parity on token accounting for 95th percentile traffic (latency within SLO) + schema stable for 2 weeks on canary. If Dedicated parity lags, fallback must preserve token fields.
Jordan Lee: Action items:
- @Anika write schema RFC draft by Thu
- @Sam add SDK PR templates to enforce fields
- @Ravi add perf test in infra pipeline
- @Maya coordinate customer comms
Anika Gomez: I'll start RFC draft and include examples for chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, and function calls. Will flag open questions inline.
Sam Wu: I'll prototype SDK changes and add compatibility layer for older field names.
Ravi Singh: I'll run quick perf sweep for adding `metadata` and `function_calls` on 1k qps streaming.
Maya Patel: OK folks — sync tomorrow 10am to finalize gating. If anyone blocks, ping here. :rocket:
DevEx Bot: RFC created: https://rwood/drafts/resp-schema-2026-03-20
Jordan Lee: Noted — thanks. 
Sam Wu: tiny nit — prefer `trace_id` as UUID v4 for cross-system correlation; include `trace_span` if we later support span-level traces.
Anika Gomez: Agreed on UUID v4. We'll standardize on `trace_id` format in RFC.
Maya Patel: Closing thread for now. Thanks all.
